name: 39501 · Gulfport, MS
findings: ZIP 39501 (Gulfport) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39501 (Gulfport) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 39501 (Gulfport) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
